_doc: Manual overrides — merged on top of live data every fetch run. Team names must match exactly what appears in the GUI.

teams._doc: Override per-team statistics. Keys are team names (case-sensitive).

players._doc: Override player rosters. Each key is a team name; value is a list of {name, rating, kd, adr, kast, od_success}. Replaces the entire roster for that team. Use the GUI editor (✏ Edit Data) to populate this.

results._doc: Extra match results for model training. Format: {team_a, team_b, winner, map (optional)}.
